description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Rules for the Appointment of Deputy Governor and Designation of the Senior Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made under Section 15(11) of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka Act, No. 16 of 2023, which establishes regulatory procedures for appointing Deputy Governors and designating the Senior Deputy Governor. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework creation rather than government personnel changes (no specific appointments are made here) or organizational restructuring. It falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory procedures for a financial institution.
